_readme: Series manifest for scripts/mx-fiscal/fetch.mjs. Each key lists candidates tried in order; the first whose provider-reported
title matches `title` (regex, case-insensitive) and whose latest value passes `guard` wins. Units are the provider's.
freq: D daily, W weekly, M monthly, Q quarterly, A annual. thin: 'monthly' keeps month-end points (the true latest point is
always kept separately as `last`). Banxico ids below were confirmed against the SIE API's own titles on 2026-09-13/18.
required: true makes the daily job fail (so GitHub emails the owner) when the series has no usable data at all.

series._pib: Nominal GDP from INEGI as republished in Banxico's SIE (sector 2, cuadro CR375, base 2018, current prices). INEGI reports each quarter at an annualised level (2026-Q2 ≈ 37.5 bn pesos), so the page uses the average of the last four quarters as the denominator for debt ratios and labels them as such; SHCP's own ratios use its annual GDP estimate.
